statut: à valider (banque d'idées n° 2, validée le 20/10)
reel_associe: reel19 (Setty : « You let that [bleep]ing lead go cold, right? »)
biais: aversion à la perte (le lead qui refroidit)

sources.fait: relances : jusqu'à 3, entre 1 et 23 h après le dernier message, dans la fenêtre de 24 h, en mots de l'IA ou de la marque

blocks.title: this is the *follow-up* i send when a lead stops replying

blocks.text: you don't want to look "desperate" or "pushy". so the lead goes cold, in silence.
sometimes they just got busy and forgot. your follow-up is the reminder.

chat.text: hey! did you still want the details on the program?

blocks.caption: short, easy to answer, zero pressure.

chat.text: no stress if now's not the time. what's holding you back, timing or budget?

blocks.caption: an easy way out, plus one question.

chat.text: i'll stop bugging you, promise. if you ever want help with your goal, just reply here.

blocks.caption: leave the door open, then stop.

blocks.heading: all 3 inside *24 hours*, then you stop chasing

blocks.text: it sends up to 3 follow-ups for you, between 1 and 23 hours after the last message, in your words or its own.

list: no lead goes cold in silence.
you never write a follow-up again.
the replies land in your DMs.

cta.line: and i'll show you how to set up your AI setter for free.
